name: app-settings-core
title: App Settings core
description: The transport, hooks and provider every App Settings component reads. Install this alone to build your own UI over App Settings resolutions with React Query.
author: Connor Doman <connor@connordoman.dev>
docs: Wrap your settings page in <AppSettingsProvider transport={...}>. Use transportFromClient(new AppSettingsClient({ ... })) to talk to App Settings directly, or createHttpTransport({ resolve, write }) to go through your own API. Set SETTINGS_URL and SETTINGS_API_KEY server-side; never ship an API key to the browser.
